Results.ReviewText: I can see why the Weber Kettle has been around so long.  This is my first one ever, all because of some YouTube videos showing how versatile this thing can be.  I completely agree.  So far each cook has been great, it's fairly easy to keep clean and the ash handling is fantastic.  I have also made good use of the fire management attachments to nice effect.  Very pleased.
Results.Title: Weber flexibility is still the greatest!

ClientResponses.Response:
We want you to have an awesome experience with your new charcoal grill. Our apologies for the difficulty you had installing the legs! We appreciate your feedback, and our Care team is here to help!

We expect our products to assemble and perform better than what you have described. It is possible that the legs are not fully inserted, causing the wobbling. 

Please look for an email outreach from our Care team. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
I have not yet used the grill but I have put it together and unfortunately I am not impressed with some basic details. 
Note that this is my first Weber grill. I actually switched from another brand since everybody’s always talking about Weber and how great they are. So I decided to sell my propane and charcoal grills and get into Weber environment. 
1- When I was assembling the Master touch grill, I had a lot of difficulties with the first leg as it would not fit in the grill’s hole. Since the manual instructed not to use hammer or force, at first I spent half an hour on that leg but it did not fit through so I started hammering it down which eventually worked but damaged the leg. 
2- The four mini shelf angle L brackets that support the stainless steel grate are not level and therefore the grate wobbles a lot. 
In general maybe these are not big issues, but I thought I would be more impressed since this is Weber comparing to my old grills. Now I am not even sure if I want to buy a propane one or not!
I will update my review once I use the grill to actually BBQ some food.
Results.Title: Not impressed

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We are so sorry to hear your experience did not match your expectations. We want to know more about what is happening with the grate not seating properly. 

We will be sharing your feedback with our team. Our Care team is reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: This is our 4th (??) Weber grill and while it's ok, there are design issues. The bolts for the lid rest protrude inside the grill and make it very hard to seat the grate, particularly when flames are shooting up at your hands. The two piece grate is also difficult to keep from falling apart when placing it, particularly because of the sharp angle needed to avoid the lid bolts. Our previous model had 2 handles and this one only has 1, which makes it hard to lift or lower the grill if needed. Overall the design with the lid rest is not as good as the original. The grate is heavy duty, which is nice, but it would be good if there were a way to lock the 2 pieces of the grate together.   The other accessories that come with this model seem high quality, but we've yet to really use them.
Results.Title: Less is more

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill. Easy to use. This is my second Weber charcoal grill. The first one lasted over 10 years.
Results.Title: The best grill you can buy.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this as a gift for my husband and he is really enjoying it and the way it grills  up meat and vegetables
Results.Title: Grilling is great!!!!

Results.ReviewText: This grill looks good, has plenty of room for cooking, gets really hot for searing, and it holds heat very well.
Results.Title: Master-Touch

Results.ReviewText: This was a gift and I use it more than my pellet grills now!
Results.Title: Charcoal Rocks!

Results.ReviewText: I owned 2 of these in the earliest model years ago. I like all the upgrades of the Master Touch, and look forward to many years of use.
Results.Title: Nice upgrade.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback, as well as your patience. We apologize for the unusual and frustrating experience you had while trying to replace parts under your grill's warranty. We are glad to learn that we were able to resolve your issue and that you are very happy with your grill!

We strive to provide outstanding and efficient customer service, and we will bring your feedback to the rest of our team. We would like to find our more about what happened, so please look for our email outreach. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: My grill arrived with several blemishes; cracks in the enamel on both the kettle and lid. Home Depot would have gladly just taken it back, but I called Weber and they offered to replace parts at no charge, so I opted for that solution. Weber, however, made several errors in the replacement process, sending parts to an old address and sending the wrong colors, too. There were numerous miscommunications that made what seemed like a simple process a very complicated situation. After several emails to Weber asking for help to fix things, a manager took over and fixed it all with great professionalism. Weber went out of their way to do what was needed to correct everything. I have my grill now and it is in order and I'm very happy with it.
Results.Title: Quite a bit of work for warranty replacements

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. First off, it stands taller than my other weber grill. Second, the design of the grilling grate, opens up on each side. Third, the indirect cooking chambers and warming rack accessories. Forth, the option for other styles of cooking using the center removable part of the grill allowing us to purchase different style cooking surfaces. Controlling heat seems to be a lot better than my other 22 inch weber grill. I really like this grill. If you like weber grills like i do, you'll love this Master Grill.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill- You will become a Master Griller

Results.ReviewText:
The best experience ever
My first grill, I just love this brand
Results.Title: It’s just awesome

Results.ReviewText:
This is our second Weber barbecue without counting many more other brands before.
Noting can beat a meal cooked on charcoal and it will be our only way to barbecue.
Results.Title: Best way to barbecue

Results.ReviewText: It has been such an amazing purchase, I wanna use it everytime
Results.Title: Fantastic grill, I really love it

Results.ReviewText: Weber Kettle; Timeless! Simple and flawless design.
Results.Title: Great all around grill + smoker.

Results.ReviewText: Really good quality  I recommend it t every one ☝️……
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText:
The  22 inch Weber Grill is my  second.  my  original is  still working great after  18 years.
I  went with the  Master  Touch for several reasons..(1)  P vent offers better  air control and flow.(2)  the  Master  Touch  is  somewhat  higher in height .  Great Quality and terrific customer service from Weber. I  also have  a  Weber  Smokey Mountain smoker  22 inch.  love it !
Results.Title: Ocean Blue Master Touch outstanding quality !

Results.ReviewText: Je suis entrain de le maîtriser et j'aime la cuisson et la variété
Results.Title: Charbon

Results.ReviewText: The upper grill components are top notch. However, the wheels and legs could be better built. The grill wobbles a bit even when everything is tight and the center of balance is odd when wheeling the grill around.
Results.Title: Great Grill Meh Legs and Wheels

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grilling pleasurable cooking steaks, chops vegetables  gonna trypizza soon
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great. I have used it now several times and the only thing I wish I had was more of the charcoal holders.
Results.Title: Get grilling done well!

Results.ReviewText: It’s a learning curve, but I have enjoyed the taste of charcoal grilled food again. I gave my pellet grill away. It was easier to use, but sacrificed flavor.
Results.Title: Love my new Weber!

Results.ReviewText: It is an awesome little grill. Makes it easy to learn how to use a charcoal grill. I still have a loot to learn, but off to a good start. It was a good addition to out smoker and griddle.
Results.Title: All around charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber is a name that is known for quality. This grill, while quite expensive, is built to last. I have multiple types of grills, and they all serve a purpose. I bought this grill to sear after my pellet grill smoke, and good old fashion charcoal burgers can’t be beat. Assembly was easy and took 10 min out of the box. I’d recommend this grill or any Weber model for a long term use charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Quality you’re used to

Results.ReviewText: Have been looking at these for a few months and finally bought one. Absolutely love it.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Weber kettle is the only grill I have ever used/will use.  I have noticed the center piece of the grate tends to slide out when brushed during cleaning,  not a com plaint, just a heads up.
Results.Title: 3rd Kettle in 25 Years

Results.ReviewText:
A great grill - really well designed and high quality. I am a big fan of charcoal grilling and the Weber is outstanding!  
I ordered it on line - great selection of colors- and the shipping was fast. The only complaint I have is the assembly is a bit of work - the instructions are great but there are 3 bolts that were seriously the hardest bolts to turn I have ever seen!  The tool Weber provided was totally inadequate- but a socket wrench did the trick (I don’t think it was possible to complete the assembly without a socket wrench- just saying). Otherwise, super pleased.
Results.Title: A great charcoal grill!

Results.ReviewText: The Weber grill in total is fantastic, my drop to four stars is r/t the center grill section. Although I believe this may be a great idea to provide other grilling options, the unaffixed center section can be a pain to deal with when doing regular care. Regular care as in cleaning the grate, lifting the grate on and off the grill for starting charcoal, the center section likes to fall our if you're not REALLY careful.
Results.Title: The center of the grill grate can be a challenge

Results.ReviewText: I only used it 2-3 times as it is winter but it is a very good buy! Many possibilities of configuration and very easy to use
Results.Title: Excellent!

Results.ReviewText:
The grill was easy to assemble and cooks great. Controlling the temperature is also
straight forward, using the damper and vents. The cooking grate with the Gourmet BBQ System is fantastic.

My only concern is that the paint is already chipped where the handle attaches to the lid.
Results.Title: My new Weber Master-Touch

Results.ReviewText: Has plenty of room and has been very easy to clean exactly what I needed.
Results.Title: Happy so far

Results.ReviewText: Perfect height.  Easy assembly.  I have a Weber gasser and an electric smoker that are now jealous and feel ignored.  This kettle cooks beautifully and with excellent flavor.  So glad I purchased it!
Results.Title: Absolutely outstanding

Results.ReviewText: Great quality! Love getting back to my Charcoal grilling roots.
Results.Title: Back to basics.

Results.ReviewText: A great grill.  My only complaint is that the vanes that clear the ashes are pretty flimsy.  If you use chunk charcoal, not briquets, and you try to save some charcoal by shutting down the vents, you are bound to get some small chucks of charcoal in the ashpit.  If you then try to clear the vents by pushing the vents back and forth, they deform when they hit these chunks and subsequently they do not work as well.
Results.Title: Nice grill!

Results.ReviewText: These things are amazing. Sold my original after getting BGE and missed it so much, got another for Christmas.
Results.Title: Love my kettle!

Photos.Caption: Running the snake method with charcoal for a 8 hour cook

Results.ReviewText: I love my new master touch. Slowly buying all GBS accessories for it. I’ve gotten the griddle and Dutch oven duo so far. This thing is a grilling machine and easy to operate from low and slow to hot and fast.
Results.Title: All you need is a Weber Kettle!

Results.ReviewText: Pretty good & versatile with accessories cooking and grilling, Steaks, Rotisserie, Pizzas, Stews; Long lasting charcoal.
Results.Title: Mr Juan

Results.ReviewText: Best grill there is, and it keeps getting better. My grandfather taught my dad on a Weber kettle grill, and my dad taught me on a Weber. My brother has had his for 13 years and it’s still rocking.
Results.Title: Best grill there is.

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill. The Weber kettle is a work of art that produces the best BBQ. Anything can be cooked well on a Weber Kettle.  I’ve smoked a Turkey on mine as well as seared the best steaks.
Results.Title: Impressive.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
